title: SAT1 adversarial research decision pilot: double-rated evidence rubric
purpose: Exploratory exercise on evidentiary caution in short research review scenarios, not a validated behavioral instrument.

rubric.observation_one_present: 1 only when the submitted explanatory text includes the first case-specific expected observation; otherwise 0.
rubric.observation_two_present: 1 only when the submitted explanatory text includes the second case-specific expected observation; otherwise 0.
rubric.source_reference_relevant: 1 only when the stated source is genuinely relevant to the specific assertion; never infer it was inspected.

method.participant_task: Seven written decision/explanation tasks bound to the exact Lean SHA-256 and casebook SHA-256
method.outcome: Descriptive double-rater binary rubric agreement; no personal ability inference
method.agreement: Observed percent agreement and Cohen kappa per dimension and pooled; undefined kappa emitted as null
